slice.layout: raw little-endian float32, channel-major (14 channels x 2000 samples), volts
slice.captured_with: readLevel0 from src/lib/eeg-viewer/store.ts (dequantized and converted to volts, the same samples the viewer reads)

reference.command: cd test/fixtures/ieeg-activity && uv run --no-project --with scipy --with numpy python reference.py
reference.method: scipy.signal.welch(x, fs=1000, window='hann', nperseg=1024, noverlap=512, detrend='constant', scaling='density'); band power = sum of density over bins lo <= f < hi times df; rms of the mean-removed samples; line length = mean(abs(diff(x))) * fs; values in microvolts

index_updated_utc_source: stores[zarr=sub-P5/ieeg/sub-P5_task-OWM_ieeg.zarr].updated_utc in https://zarr.nemar.org/on006136/zarr/index.json (equal to that file's top-level updated_utc); an index field, not an object timestamp of the store
